title.narrative: 2026 Syria Regional Appeal - Jordan - Repair, Maintenance and Rehabilitation of UNRWA Installations

description.narrative: In 2025, maintenance will be undertaken at 38 UNRWA (non-school) installations, including health centres, environmental health offices and other administration offices. A comprehensive assessment will evaluate key factors, such as structural integrity and protection-related issues, to prioritise installations requiring urgent interventions. Pre-established criteria will ensure that installations are prioritised for rehabilitation and/or maintenance, within available resources, on the basis of service delivery needs and the safety of Palestine refugees and UNRWA personnel.
